body.x: Zero-defect manufacturing depends on inspecting parts as they move through production. Images from different types of cameras must be captured and analyzed in real time on the factory floor, without being sent to remote servers.

Video Systems, an Italian deep-tech company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Codroipo, with a research unit in Trento, builds machine vision and AI for that job. Led by CEO Alessandro Liani, it is presenting Ingenium AI eco-system at KES 2026 with the EU Business Hub delegation, and says it wants to build collaborations with customers and technology partners in Korea and across Asia.

Ingenium AI eco-system is an integrated edge AI platform for industrial in-line inspection. Its Ingenium AI Edge Rack combines a hybrid DSP/GPU architecture, with four 64-bit floating-point digital signal processor (DSP) units, to acquire and process data from up to eight RGB, infrared and multispectral cameras in real time. An NVIDIA Jetson Orin runs AI inference on the production floor, and the total power draw stays below 150 W. Ingenium AI Suite covers the full AI workflow, from image collection and annotation to dataset management, training, validation, optimization, edge deployment and model monitoring.

Ingenium AI eco-system was selected as a winner of the 15th KES Innovation Awards in the AI Transformation (AX) category in 2026. Video Systems operates under the Imago, Adamantis, Ingenium and Apicus brands and has worked on AI since 2001. It says it has more than 8,000 systems installed in 48 countries, in sectors including steel, pharmaceutical glass, automotive and food production.

The company participates in projects funded under the EU's Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe programs. It plans to keep expanding its machine vision, edge AI and quality control business and, through KES 2026 and the EU Business Hub, to learn local requirements and identify partners among Korean manufacturers. It says it has identified no specific market-entry difficulties so far.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
